description: Redesign Dashboard and MensionePickCard with Premium AI Terminal aesthetic - PRIMARY visual redesign. Transform prediction cards with dark navy→deep purple gradients, thin neon blue/purple borders, restrained glow, enhanced AI confidence with blue glow on existing money-bag icon. Update Dashboard heading with blue→purple gradient, redesign filter buttons, update LiveMatchesPanel with restrained red live indicator. This is the most critical visual component.
steps: 1. Read frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.css - current dashboard layout and title styling

2. Update Dashboard.css .dashboard-title with blue→purple gradient: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6 0%, #8b5cf6 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; background-clip: text; text-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); for restrained glow on 'MENSIONE PICKS' heading

3. Update Dashboard.css .filter-btn for dark glass compact buttons: background: rgba(26, 26, 36, 0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; - active state: background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15); border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); color: var(--color-accent-blue); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15);
4. Read frontend/src/components/predictions/MensionePickCard.css - MAIN REDESIGN TARGET - current dark green cards

5. Update MensionePickCard.css .mensione-pick-card: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a28 0%, #1e1a2e 100%); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1); for dark navy→purple gradient with blue neon border and restrained glow

6. Update MensionePickCard.css hover state: border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.15), 0 0 12px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.08); for stronger blue/purple glow on hover

7. Update MensionePickCard.css collapsed header sections: ensure pick-badge uses blue accent: background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3); color: var(--color-accent-blue);

8. Update MensionePickCard.css intelligence tabs: .intelligence-tab--active { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12); color: var(--color-accent-blue); border-bottom-color: #3b82f6; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3); } for blue active tab instead of green

9. Update MensionePickCard.css tab content light surface sections - keep existing light backgrounds for readability but update accent colors: .match-light-green references should use blue accents where appropriate for highlights

10. Update MensionePickCard.css combine CTA button: keep functionality but update to blue theme: background: rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.3); color: var(--color-accent-blue); - hover and selected states use stronger blue glow

12. Update AIConfidence.css active money-bag icons with ELECTRIC BLUE glow instead of green: .ai-confidence__icon--active { color: var(--color-accent-blue); } - update glow levels: --glow-1: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.25)), --glow-2: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.35)), --glow-3: drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(14, 165, 233, 0.45)), --glow-4: drop-shadow(0 0 9px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.55)), --glow-5: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.65)) brightness(1.1), --glow-6: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.75)) drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.3)) brightness(1.2) - CRITICAL: DO NOT modify the SVG icon itself in AIConfidence.tsx, only update CSS glow effects
13. Read frontend/src/components/predictions/AIConfidence.tsx to verify money-bag SVG icon structure - do NOT change the SVG paths, only verify the component accepts className props for glow styling
14. If AIConfidence.tsx needs className additions for proper glow application, add them minimally (e.g., add className to wrapper div if needed) - PRESERVE all existing SVG code
15. Read frontend/src/components/dashboard/LiveMatchesPanel.css - current live panel with red pulse
16. Update LiveMatchesPanel.css: .live-matches-panel { background: rgba(26, 26, 36, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); } for glass effect and blue border
17. Update LiveMatchesPanel.css live indicator: keep red color but make restrained - ensure .live-indicator__dot animation is subtle, not aggressive casino-style pulse
18. Read frontend/src/components/dashboard/LiveMatchCard.css if exists, apply same dark glass + blue border treatment
19. Verify all changes preserve existing functionality: favorite button, expand/collapse, tab switching, combine selection, technical details toggle
